Use case: style-transfer. Edit the ORIGINAL GAME SCREENSHOT into a much more carefully drawn version of the SAME original 2D game. This is an ambitious premium flat-art upgrade. The before/after quality improvement must be immediately obvious at phone size.
Preserve the entire portrait framing and exact visible state: same playfield geometry, positions, counts, character/item identities, functional colors, recognizable poses, functional footprints, HUD footprints, tutorial cue, wording and numeric values. Push craft through exceptionally clean contours, deliberate line-weight consistency, refined source-faithful expressions, precise shape construction, tidy alignment and very clear small-screen symbols. Push the quality gap much further: bespoke expressive character drawings, beautifully controlled curves and silhouettes, expertly balanced positive/negative shapes, confident purposeful outlines where the source uses them, high-quality pictogram design, a richer and more intentional flat-color palette with excellent value separation, and crisp distinctive typography inside the same UI footprints. Give the existing art charm and authored personality. Rebuild the drawing and interface craft to a polished premium 2D-game standard, rather than merely enlarging or tracing blurry source pixels. Preserve recognizable species, product/category identities and functional color coding.
Render every element as completely FLAT, UNLIT 2D artwork: opaque solid color fills, crisp vector-like edges, only the original semantic color separations and outlines. ZERO SHADOWS: no drop, contact, cast or self shadows. No ambient occlusion, directional light, gradient shading, specular highlights, glossy reflections, bevels, extrusion, volumetric forms, bloom, glow, texture, grain or material rendering. Flatten any existing lighting treatment into clean solid color areas without changing silhouettes, overlap or layer order. Backgrounds are flat color fields or hard-edged color bands, never lighting gradients.
Retain decorative background imagery in its original locations as flat shapes. Do not add props, foliage, patterns, particles, panels or UI. Do not inflate gameplay footprints or round everything into toys, change camera perspective, zoom, crop, add empty margins, add a frame or place new labels on the image. All text stays exactly verbatim. Same frozen gameplay state, with stronger flat drawing and finish. Output one full-bleed portrait image at the reference aspect ratio.


INPUT ROLES: Image 1 is the ORIGINAL screenshot and the geometry/state authority. Image 2 is the current flat draft to improve; do not preserve any gradient, shadow or erroneous detail from it.

GAME-SPECIFIC FIDELITY CONSTRAINTS:
Preserve seven rows by three shelf cells, every occupied/vacant slot, stack identity, headline and product label.
The translucent FRUIT carton is a tutorial drag ghost for one physical carton; do not count it as a duplicate. Keep the hand shape and size close to the original.

one uniform opaque solid color per shape, zero gradients anywhere; all buttons/counters/hand also completely unlit flat with outlines rather than shadow; do not add decorative labels

TARGETED SECOND REVISION: The current draft is too close to basic outlined clip-art and still has tonal ramps. Make a premium set of coherent, beautifully drawn flat product icons: confident outer contours, finer controlled inner details, more expressive but source-faithful toy faces, elegant product curves and excellent small-size legibility. Keep every shelf item and occupied/vacant slot exactly as the original. Each shelf interior is ONE solid dark teal; each wood frame piece ONE solid warm ochre; each skin area ONE solid peach; no gradients on any item. Preserve all product labels verbatim, and the single tutorial carton ghost without duplicating a physical carton.

LATEST ART DIRECTION: Push toward Studio Ghibli-quality hand-drawn 2D craft: expressive bespoke characters, elegant controlled hand-drawn linework with tasteful variation, emotionally warm art-directed colors, and beautifully simplified background shapes. This must feel lovingly authored and substantially more accomplished than generic vector tracing or thick sticker outlines. Keep completely flat cel-color areas: no painterly gradients, texture, lighting, shading or 3D. Reinterpret drawing craft only; original species/product/tier identities, counts, states, sizes, positions, camera, text and readable UI remain fixed.
